description: This file defines a wrapper class for AAudio input stream, including methods for opening, closing, starting, stopping, and configuring the stream, as well as callback functions for audio data processing and error handling. It also includes structures and functions for peak amplitude tracking during audio recording.

classes.name: AAudioSimpleRecorder
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing an AAudio input stream, including configuration, control, and data handling.

methods.name: setSharingMode
methods.description: Sets the requested sharing mode for the audio stream.

methods.name: setPerformanceMode
methods.description: Sets the requested performance mode for the audio stream.

methods.name: getFramesPerSecond
methods.description: Returns the sample rate (alias for getSampleRate).

methods.name: getSampleRate
methods.description: Retrieves the sample rate of the open stream.

methods.name: getChannelCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of channels in the open stream.

methods.name: getFramesRead
methods.description: Returns the number of frames read from the stream.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens an audio input stream with specified parameters or callback functions.

methods.name: prime
methods.description: Fills the buffer with zeros to prevent underruns.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the audio stream, enabling callback invocation.
